extDescription.message: Ambient lighting for YouTube™ videos: the colors of the video softly light up the whole page.
extDescription.description: Short description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions (max 132 characters).

buttonLabelOn.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the player button when the effect is enabled.

buttonLabelOff.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the player button when the effect is disabled.

menuTitle.description: Accessible name of the settings menu.

menuAmbientLight.description: Main on/off switch in the menu.

menuImmersive.description: Switch that dims the suggested videos.

menuImmersiveHint.message: Dims suggested thumbnails until you hover them
menuImmersiveHint.description: Short explanation under the immersive mode switch.

presetCustom.description: Shown when the sliders no longer match a preset.

settingIntensity.description: Slider: overall strength of the light.

settingSpread.description: Slider: how far the light reaches.

settingSmoothing.description: Slider (advanced): how slowly colors follow the video.

settingEdge.description: Slider (advanced): how deep into the video border colors are picked.

savePreset.description: Button that saves the current sliders as a new preset.

presetNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the preset name field.

deletePreset.description: Accessible label of the × button of a custom preset; followed by its name.

defaultPresetName.description: Default name proposed for a new preset; a number is appended.

reset.description: Button that restores the Balanced look.

menuDarkTip.message: The effect looks best in dark theme.
menuDarkTip.description: Notice in the menu when YouTube uses the light theme.

welcomeTitle.description: Title of the one-time welcome bubble.

welcomeBody.message: Click the light bulb to pick a style and fine-tune the light.

darkThemeTip.message: Tip: the effect looks even better in dark theme (profile picture › Appearance).
darkThemeTip.description: One-time tip shown when YouTube uses the light theme.

gotIt.description: Button that closes a tip bubble.
